extracted_concepts.name: 波动方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂²u/∂t² = c²∂²u/∂x²

extracted_concepts.name: 达朗贝尔解
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u(x,t) = f(x-ct) + g(x+ct)

extracted_concepts.name: 弦振动
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 波动方程描述的弦振动现象

extracted_concepts.name: 声波

extracted_concepts.name: 电磁波

extracted_concepts.name: 热传导方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂u/∂t = k∂²u/∂x²

extracted_concepts.name: 温度分布
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 热传导方程描述的温度分布

extracted_concepts.name: 扩散过程

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: t > 0 时热传导方程解立即变光滑

extracted_concepts.name: 拉普拉斯方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂²u/∂x² + ∂²u/∂y² = 0

extracted_concepts.name: 稳态温度
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 拉普拉斯方程描述的稳态温度

extracted_concepts.name: 电势

extracted_concepts.name: 调和函数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 满足拉普拉斯方程的函数

extracted_concepts.name: 分离变量法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 假设 u(x,t) = X(x)·T(t) 并代入 PDE 分离变量

extracted_concepts.name: 初边值问题
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 同时给出初始条件和边界条件的问题

extracted_concepts.name: 特征值问题
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: X'' + λX = 0 及边界条件构成的问题

extracted_concepts.name: 正弦特征函数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: X_n(x) = sin(nπx/L)

extracted_concepts.name: 级数解
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 用特征函数展开得到的级数形式解

extracted_concepts.name: 傅里叶级数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f(x) = a₀/2 + Σ[aₙcos(nπx/L) + bₙsin(nπx/L)]

extracted_concepts.name: 傅里叶系数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: aₙ 和 bₙ 由积分公式确定

extracted_concepts.name: Parseval 等式
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (1/L)∫|f(x)|²dx = a₀²/2 + Σ(aₙ² + bₙ²)

extracted_concepts.name: Dirichlet 条件
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 分段光滑函数的傅里叶级数收敛条件

extracted_concepts.name: 傅里叶分析
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 以傅里叶级数为核心的分析工具
